metrics.name: 우대금리_적용율
metrics.sql_template:
SELECT (base_rate - applied_rate) AS value
FROM account_rate WHERE account_id = :account_id

metrics.name: 전월실적
metrics.sql_template:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS value FROM txn
WHERE account_id = :account_id
  AND approved_at >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month'
  AND approved_at <  date_trunc('month', now())
  AND status = 'APPROVED'

metrics.name: 담보인정비율
metrics.description: 담보평가액 대비 대출가능액 비율 (규정 REG-LN-014 기준)
metrics.sql_template:
SELECT (loan_limit / collateral_value * 100) AS value
FROM loan_assessment WHERE account_id = :account_id

metrics.name: 잔여한도
metrics.sql_template:
SELECT (limit_amount - outstanding) AS value
FROM loan_account WHERE account_id = :account_id
